newsitem.title: CANADA: Coral Energy, Shell Canada close gas deal.
newsitem.headline: Coral Energy, Shell Canada close gas deal.

text.p: Houston-based Coral Energy LP and Shell Canada Ltd said on Wednesday they closed their previously announced natural gas marketing alliance with Shell Canada taking a 12 percent stake in Coral.
Shell Canada's marketing business was combined with Coral on May 31, the companies said.
Under the deal, Coral markets Shell Canada's 800 million cubic feet a day of gas volumes, bringing its total to 6.9 million cubic feet a day across North America, they said.
The remaining interest in Coral is held equally by Shell Oil Co and Tejas Gas Corp.
"The addition of Shell Canada's natural gas marketing operations accomplishes key objectives for Coral," Coral Chief Executive Murry Gerber said in a statement.
"We immediately become a major player in the Canadian gas market, and we establish a stronger position for marketing in the U.S. Midwest and West Coast."

With the Shell Canada entry, Coral's resources provided by its parent firms include about five billion cubic feet a day of gas production and supplies, over 7.5 trillion cubic feet of reserves, more than 10,600 miles of intrastate pipelines and gas storage capacity of 155 billion cubic feet, the companies said. ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
